statement: 在不可改变的 sklearn digits 固定评估协议上，寻找一个可复现、无测试集泄漏的分类器，使 metrics.json 中的测试集 accuracy 尽可能高；0.99 是本轮最多 5 次实验内的挑战阈值。若未达到该阈值，必须基于已完成实验给出最有证据的方案、失败原因和剩余瓶颈，而不能把阈值未达成改写成成功。该基准结果只代表固定协议下的 Harness 集成质量，不宣称真实业务场景的泛化性能。

candidate_ideas: 在固定预处理边界内比较高容量且适合 digits 的核方法超参数
比较不依赖额外数据的线性或非线性分类器，并以固定测试协议验证
优先复核已完成 RBF-SVM 结果的参数方向，再选择一个信息增益最高的单一候选

stopping.success_condition: A completed, protocol-valid run reports metrics.json accuracy >= 0.99; training_time_s is also reported for comparison.
stopping.fallback_condition: After 5 experiments without the threshold, stop and report the best completed valid run, evidence-weighted choice, failed-run causes, and remaining bottleneck.

hard_requirements: Use the fixed sklearn digits dataset and the existing stratified 75/25 split with seed 42.
Evaluate the primary metric as test-set accuracy from metrics.json and maximize it.
Do not fit, select, or tune using test-set labels or test-set-derived information.
Do not modify goal.json, baseline_metrics.json, existing research history, or the evaluation protocol.
Use no more than 5 experiment runs, at most one newly started run per turn, and do not wait for a run already in RUNNING state.
Every performance conclusion must come from a completed run with status COMPLETED and a parseable metrics.json.
If the challenge threshold is missed within the budget, provide the required evidence-based fallback analysis.
soft_preferences: Prefer lower training_time_s when accuracy is tied or practically indistinguishable.
Prefer a simple, reproducible model that fits within the existing wall-time and memory constraints.
Prefer candidates supported by the existing completed-run evidence before exploring unrelated model families.
rejected_requirements: Treat accuracy >= 0.99 as proof of real-world business performance or generalization beyond this fixed benchmark.
Treat training_time_s as a hard acceptance gate without an explicit latency SLA.
Change the split, seed, dataset, baseline, goal.json, or historical research records to improve the score.
Use test-set performance for repeated hyperparameter selection without acknowledging protocol contamination.
Declare success from a failed run, an absent metric, or a metric that is not present in metrics.json.

reasoning_summary.measurability: accuracy is directly emitted by train.py into metrics.json; training_time_s is emitted as a comparable secondary metric.
reasoning_summary.business_relevance: the stated use is a Harness integration test, so the relevant business question is protocol fidelity and reproducible optimization, not deployment-grade generalization.
reasoning_summary.metric_importance: accuracy is the requested quality outcome; training_time_s captures efficiency but has no supplied SLA and therefore remains secondary.
reasoning_summary.leakage_review: train.py fits only on X_train/y_train and predicts X_test/y_test after the fixed stratified split; no current leakage was found, but future candidates must preserve this boundary.
reasoning_summary.evidence_review: baseline accuracy is 0.9777777777777777; completed historical runs report 0.9800000000000000 to 0.9822222222222222; two failures were environmental or invocation failures and are not model evidence.
reasoning_summary.revision_basis: The original threshold is retained as an explicit challenge threshold and fallback trigger, while the contract separates hard protocol obligations from soft efficiency preferences and prevents benchmark overclaiming.
